chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkkil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated that Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sinan, on the authority of Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir, on the authority of Sa'd ibn Tarif, on the authority of al-Asbagh ibn al-Nubata, who said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:

There are three sources of sedition: love for women, which is Satan's sword; drinking wine, which is Satan's trap; and love for the dinar and dirham, which is Satan's arrow. Whoever loves women will not benefit from his life; whoever loves drinks will be deprived of Paradise; and whoever loves the dinar and dirham is a servant of this world.

And he said: Jesus, son of Mary (peace be upon him) said, 'The dinar is the ailment of religion, and the scholar is the doctor of religion. So when you see the doctor bringing the ailment to himself, suspect him, and know that he is not sincere to others.'
ai.seo_question: What are the three sources of sedition according to Imam Ali and what is the metaphor of the doctor and the dinar?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Khisal*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) categorizes the root causes of spiritual deviation into three distinct forms of attachment: sensual desire (women), intoxication (wine), and materialism (wealth), metaphorically describing them as Satan's sword, trap, and arrow. He extends this diagnostic framework by citing Jesus (peace be upon him) to illustrate the integrity of the scholar; just as a doctor must be free from the disease he treats, a religious authority must be free from the worldly attachments he warns against, ensuring his guidance is sincere and effective.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-91 Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn al-Hussein al-Sa’ed Abadi quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Barqi, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sinan, on the authority of Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir, on the authority of Sa’ed ibn Tarif, on the authority of Al-Asbagh ibn al-Nubata that the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (a.s.) said: “

There are three sources of sedition. They are: love for women - that is Satan’s sword; drinking wine - that is Satan’s trap; and love for gold and silver - that is Satan’s bullet! Whoever loves women will not benefit from his life! Whoever drinks wine will not be let into Paradise! Whoever loves gold and silver will be a servant of this world!”

The Commander of the Faithful (a.s.) added, “Jesus - the son of Mary (a.s.) said, ‘Gold is the ailment for religion! The knowledgeable one is the doctor for religion! Whenever you notice that the doctor is ill, do not expect him to be able to treat you!’”
